content: A closed mind is like a closed book: nothing more than a dense block of wood.
author: Chinese Proverbs
explanation: A leather-bound volume containing the deepest secrets of human astronomy or poetry is completely useless if kept shut on a dusty shelf; it has no more intelligence than firewood. So too is the human intellect when locked behind pride and preconceived notions.
practicalInsight: Crack open the pages of your curiosity today. Ask someone about an experience you know nothing about and listen with awe.
reflectionPrompt: Where has dogmatic certainty closed the book of your mind against discovering deeper truth?
